name: Peripheral batteries
author: Tim Patzelt
description: Battery levels for wireless mice, keyboards, headsets and controllers in the Omarchy bar, read from UPower.

barWidget.description: How much charge is left in your mouse, keyboard, headset or controller — with a panel and a low-battery warning.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: Peripheral batteries report in whole percent and drain over weeks; UPower itself only refreshes most of them every couple of minutes.

schema.label: Low battery threshold (%)
schema.description: At or below this a device turns the theme's urgent colour and, once, sends a notification.

schema.label: Show every device
schema.description: Off shows only the emptiest one, which keeps the bar to a single chip.

schema.label: Only show devices below (%)
schema.description: 100 shows everything. Lower it to keep full devices off the bar until they start running down. Charging devices are always shown.

schema.label: Notify on low battery
schema.description: One desktop notification per device as it crosses the threshold, not one per refresh.

schema.label: Show icons
schema.description: Turn off for a text-only readout if your font lacks the Nerd Font glyphs.

schema.label: Include the machine's own battery
schema.description: Off by default — Omarchy already has a battery indicator for that.

schema.label: Hide these device kinds
schema.description: JSON array of UPower kinds such as ["phone", "media-player"].

schema.label: Right-click command
schema.description: Leave empty to have right-click refresh instead of running a command.

schema.label: Dump command (advanced)
schema.description: JSON array, default ["upower", "--dump"]. Point it at ["cat", "/path/to/dump.txt"] to preview devices you don't have.
